subject: Commit-signal triage & stale-opps sweep — action needed
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commit-signal triage & stale-opps sweep — action needed

Team —

Finance flagged a material gap in our committed pipeline for the Q4 forecast. They want to see commit-signal evidence for deals listed as "Commit" or "Commit at risk" and a cleanup pass for opportunities with no stage movement or updated close dates in 60+ days.

Quick plan:
- Owners: run through the attached stale-opps CSV and apply one of three outcomes per opp: Commit (with evidence), Likely no-go (archive), or Re-qualify with new close date.
- Thresholds: No stage or close-date change in 60 days -> triage candidate.
- Evidence: update SFDC with next-step note, calendar invite, PO/procurement email, or signed SOW link.
- Deadline: please complete your assigned rows in the CSV, update SFDC, and reply to this thread with a one-line summary by EOD Thu Oct 14.

Attachments: stale-opps-list-q4.csv (your assigned slice), triage-playbook-q4.pdf (playbook + sample note templates). Also shared a SFDC saved report for quick filtering: https://redwood.lightning.force.com/00O5g000004XyzR?filter=stale_opps_report

Ask: Lauren, Rishi — can you split the list and confirm which accounts you own? I can reassign rows in the CSV after you confirm. Finance wants a clean signal before Friday close.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Thanks Priyom — good call. Quick clarifying q's:
1) For the 60-day threshold, do we include deals that had a minor stage change (e.g., "Proposal" -> "Proposal - sent") but the close date hasn't moved?
2) If an opportunity has an active procurement conversation (email thread exists) but no PO yet, do we mark as "Commit (evidence: procurement thread)" or leave as "Likely no-go" until a PO/SOW?

I can take the east-coast book (accounts with billing addresses in US-E and US-NE). I'll mark rows in the CSV and ping owners for any ambiguous items.

-Lauren

Lauren — great, thanks. Answers: 
- Include minor stage sub-state changes as movement only if the close date or next-step note was updated in SFDC in the past 60 days. If it's only a UI sub-state tweak with no activity, treat as stale.
- Procurement thread without PO: mark as "Commit (evidence: procurement thread)" only if there is a documented procurement timeline in the thread (e.g., committed to a PO by X date). Otherwise mark as "Re-qualify" and add the next-step (date to follow up or required deliverable).

I uploaded the triage playbook and sample update templates here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqZ-triage-playbook and attached a CSV slice for each of you. I've pre-assigned rows based on recent activity; feel free to reassign.

If you prefer, Rishi and I can do a quick 15-min sync to go through any murky accounts (Helios Medical looks fuzzy).

Thanks,
Priyom
